meta.name: The Chaser
meta.description: Joong-ho is a dirty detective turned pimp, who's in financial trouble as several of his girls have recently disappeared without clearing their debts. While trying to track them down, he finds a clue that the vanished girls were all called up by the same client, whom one of his girls is meeting with right now.
meta.slogan: The hunter and the hunted, the ultimate chase begins.
